question: Which dead stores of a chained zero initialisation survive MSC 6.00AX /Og (fastcall, /Oe)? Positive control root:259D win_PrintTextInRect (worker resG): the original stores 0 into two slots that are never read ([bp-4], [bp-0Ch]). They are reproduced by (1) a local 'start' whose only read, 'if (brk == start)', is replaced by the propagated constant 0 -- its store is kept although the compare reads the constant; and (2) the stack home of the enregistered counter i (in DI), which receives its own store at i's position in the chain 'done = start = i = brk = pixw = 0' (rightmost stored first, then 'mov di,ax'). Negative contrast: comparing with the literal 0 and a chain without 'start' drops both stores (frame 0xB4 instead of 0xB6, 379 instead of 382 bytes).
